business_summary:
American Drive Acquisition Company focuses on effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities focusing defense, logistics, transportation, technology and AI sectors. The company was formerly known as American Dynamism Acquisition Company and changed its name to American Drive Acquisition Company in September 2025. American Drive Acquisition Company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Washington, 
District Of Columbia.
business_summary_ko:
American Drive Acquisition Company는 국방, 물류, 운송, 기술 및 AI 부문에 초점을 맞춘 하나 이상의 기업 또는 단체와의 합병, 합병, 주식 교환, 자산 인수, 주식 구매, 개편 또는 유사한 사업 결합을 수행하는 데 중점을 둡니다. 이 회사는 이전에 American Dynamism Acquisition Company로 알려졌으며 2025년 9월에 American Drive Acquisition Company로 이름을 변경했습니다. American Drive Acquisition Company는 2025년에 설립되었으며 워싱턴에 본사를 두고 있습니다. 
컬럼비아 특별구.
